name: @repo/platform
description: The platform ports (Db, BlobStore, Config, defer) and everything about them that is not tied to a platform: config parsing, media rules, blob tokens and URLs, the in-memory blob store, the contract suites and the test platform. Nothing here may import Cloudflare (guard: platform-boundary); adapters live in @repo/platform-cloudflare. contract/ and testing/ are test-only.
